questions.question: For Nebraska Medicine as a whole, what belongs in the lean clinical enterprise, and should UNMC be included as an owned hospital or entity?
As of July 25, 2026, are Omaha Community Foundation and Clarkson Regional Health Services current members or owners of Nebraska Medicine?

For The Nebraska Medical Center and Bellevue Medical Center, which operator EIN and facility CCN belong to each, and does Bellevue's disregarded-entity tax treatment erase its separate operator record?
Which EIN belongs to the Nebraska Medicine parent, and may UNMC Physicians or UNMC be treated as the same entity or inherit that EIN?

required: Select nebraska_medicine_clinical_enterprise_2026 as the lean clinical-enterprise perimeter.

Include the Nebraska Medicine parent, The Nebraska Medical Center, UNMC Physicians as a distinct faculty medical group, and Bellevue Medical Center LLC plus its separately certified facility beneath TNMC's supported tax-control chain.
Exclude UNMC from the owned clinical-operator core and retain it as a separate public University of Nebraska campus and academic partner.
Distinguish the Nebraska Medicine system/brand concept from the same-named legal parent corporation.
accepted: UNMC may be shown in a broader governance or academic ecosystem if it remains a separate node and is not assigned Nebraska Medicine identifiers.
Describe the clinical perimeter as membership-only rather than an audited financial consolidation.
failures: Treat UNMC as an owned Nebraska Medicine hospital, subsidiary, or alias.
Omit Bellevue or erase its separate licensed operator and CCN.
Present the result as an exhaustive or audited consolidated perimeter.

required: State that the answer is time-boxed to the interim articles and bylaws effective 2026-07-01 through 2026-09-30.
Identify the University of Nebraska Board of Regents as the sole legal member during that interim period.
State that Omaha Community Foundation appoints two of four voting directors but is not proved to be a completed corporate member or owner under the effective interim articles.
State that Clarkson Regional Health Services is no longer a current governing member after 2026-06-30 and should be preserved only as a historical relationship.
accepted: Say that possible future OCF membership remained prospective in the reviewed official materials.
Distinguish director appointment rights, membership, and ownership.
failures: Call Omaha Community Foundation a current 50 percent owner or member.
Treat equal voting-director representation as equal corporate ownership.
Retain Clarkson as a current member.
Omit the interim period or present the structure as timeless.

required: Map The Nebraska Medical Center to EIN 91-1858433 and CCN 280013.
Map Bellevue Medical Center, LLC to EIN 20-4305186 and Bellevue Medical Center facility to CCN 280132.

Preserve Bellevue Medical Center LLC as the separately licensed operator even though TNMC's return for the period ended 2023-06-30 reports Bellevue as a disregarded entity directly controlled by TNMC.
Keep operator EINs and facility CCNs separately typed and attached to their own records.
accepted: Mention NPI 1356307581 for Nebraska Medical Center and NPI 1609007525 for Bellevue only if they remain separate from EIN and CCN fields.
Note that Bellevue's current equity percentages remain unresolved.
failures: Assign CCN 280013 or EIN 91-1858433 to Bellevue.
Assign CCN 280132 or EIN 20-4305186 to The Nebraska Medical Center.
Erase Bellevue's LLC/operator record because of disregarded-entity tax treatment.
Use one CCN for both hospitals or infer current equity percentages.

required: Identify UNMC Physicians as a distinct faculty medical group with EIN 47-0785575 and Nebraska Medicine as its sole member under the interim articles.
Identify UNMC as a separate public-university campus and external academic partner, not the same entity as UNMC Physicians or Nebraska Medicine.
State that the 2025 UNMC form supports tax ID 47-0049123 only for the named University payee and leaves campus-versus-system scope unresolved.
accepted: Explain that shared branding, campus, mission, dual employment, teaching, research, or HIPAA arrangements do not authorize identifier inheritance.
Avoid using the UNMC tax ID if the scope caveat is also stated.
failures: Use TNMC EIN 91-1858433 as the Nebraska Medicine parent EIN.
Merge UNMC Physicians into UNMC or assign either entity the parent's EIN.
Assign tax ID 47-0049123 to Nebraska Medicine or claim it is definitively campus-only or system-wide.
Treat shared names or affiliations as proof of legal identity.
